name: aegis-harness
description: Local-first IDE discovery, lean contract verification, and mechanical code gate.

scripts.aegis:typecheck: if [ -n "$(find src -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then tsc --noEmit; fi
scripts.aegis:verify-structure: npm run aegis:typecheck && npm run aegis:lint && node scripts/aegis_cli.mjs check --skip-diff
scripts.aegis:test: npm run aegis:test:workspace-skeleton && npm run aegis:test:issue-intake && npm run aegis:test:discovery-and-cli
